settings.title: Settings
settings.savedNote: Changes are saved as soon as you make them.
settings.clipboard: Offer to add YouTube links I copy
settings.keyIntro: Splitwatch works without a key. Your own free key turns on search and shows which streams are live. It is kept encrypted by your system and only sent to YouTube.
settings.keyUnsaved: Save the API key you typed?

keyState.unavailable: This system offers no secure place for the key, so Splitwatch cannot keep one.

keyFailed.invalid-key: YouTube refused this key. Copy it again from the Google Cloud Console.
keyFailed.api-disabled: Turn on the YouTube Data API v3 for the key's project, then try again.
keyFailed.quota: The key's project has no quota left today.
keyFailed.network: YouTube could not be reached. Check the internet connection.
keyFailed.unavailable: This system offers no secure place for the key.
keyFailed.error: The key could not be checked. Try again later.

settings.guideTitle: How to get a free key
settings.guide1: Open the Google Cloud Console and sign in with a Google account.
settings.guide2: Create a project (any name), then open APIs and Services, Library.
settings.guide3: Find YouTube Data API v3 and click Enable.
settings.guide4: Open Credentials, choose Create credentials, API key, and copy the key.
settings.guide5: Optional but wise: edit the key and restrict it to the YouTube Data API v3.
settings.quotaResets: Resets at {time, time, short} (midnight Pacific Time).
settings.animateNote: Only while they show: on the start screen and in empty places of the grid.
settings.performanceNote: Simpler, still backgrounds and no transitions, for slower computers.
settings.background: Keep Splitwatch in the {platform, select, darwin {menu bar} other {notification area}} when its window closes
settings.backgroundNote: The streams stop with the window. Splitwatch keeps an eye on what is live, and its icon opens the window again.
settings.startAtLogin: Start Splitwatch when I sign in
settings.startHidden: Start in the {platform, select, darwin {menu bar} other {notification area}}, without a window
settings.startUnavailable: Starting with the system works in the installed app.
settings.startApproval: macOS asks for your approval: System Settings, General, Login Items.
